safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Failure to document safety-netting to seek earlier review if symptoms worsen could contribute to delayed reassessment if the rash progresses, becomes infected, or systemic symptoms develop. While not inherently likely to cause severe harm in most eczema flares, it can increase the chance of avoidable deterioration before follow-up.
